title: Dealer Covenant Schedule by Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade
content:
The covenants a dealership carries under the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line apply by grade. The schedule below sets, for each Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade, whether a personal guaranty of the dealer principal is required, how often financial statements are due, the interval between full credit reviews, whether the dealer may also hold a Kestrel capital or real-estate loan, the minimum inventory insurance, and the notice period before a change in the rate spread takes effect.

## Covenant schedule

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Dealer principal's personal guaranty required | Financial statements submitted | Months between full credit reviews | May also hold a Kestrel capital or real-estate loan | Minimum dealer inventory insurance, percent of the line | Calendar days of notice before a spread change takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | Yes | Monthly | 6 | No | 100 | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | Yes | Monthly | 6 | No | 100 | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | Yes | Monthly | 12 | Yes | 100 | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | Yes | Monthly | 12 | Yes | 100 | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | No | Quarterly | 12 | Yes | 100 | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | No | Quarterly | 12 | Yes | 100 | 30 |

## Terms as defined for this schedule

- **Personal guaranty**: whether the dealer principal's personal guaranty is required.
- **Financial statements**: how often dealership financial statements must be submitted.
- **Credit review interval**: months between full credit reviews of the line.
- **Capital or real-estate loan eligibility**: whether the dealer may also hold a Kestrel capital or real-estate loan.
- **Inventory insurance**: minimum dealer inventory insurance as a percent of the line.
- **Rate change notice**: calendar days of notice before a spread change takes effect.

## Points of reading

- The guaranty requirement divides the grades in two: Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 through Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 require the dealer principal's personal guaranty; Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 and Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 do not.
- Monthly financial statements and a 6-month review cycle go together only at Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 and Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5; from Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 upward the full credit review falls every 12 months.
- A Kestrel capital or real-estate loan alongside the line is open from Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 through Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 and closed at Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 and Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5.
- Inventory insurance of at least 100 percent of the line and 30 calendar days of notice before a spread change are the same on every grade.
